metadata.title: @capgo/capacitor-intent-launcher
metadata.description: Capacitor plugin to launch Android intents and open system settings screens on Android and iOS.

hero.tagline: Capacitor Intent Launcher Plugin for launching Android intents and opening system settings on both Android and iOS.

blocks.text: Capacitor Intent Launcher Plugin for launching Android intents and opening system settings on both Android and iOS.
